    ClockConfig
    Exposes a single Clock bean so any time-aware adapter (notably InMemoryJwtDenylistAdapter) can be tested with a fixed or offset clock without monkey-patching Instant.now().
    SchedulingConfig
    Activates Spring's task-scheduling infrastructure so @Scheduled methods — notably the InMemoryJwtDenylistAdapter sweep — fire on the configured cadence.
